findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed multiple items in walk in cooler to be stored on floor. Discussed with PIC, items were moved to at least 6 inches off of ground. Ensure any food item is stored at least 6 inches off of ground to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Observed the following locations to have significant food splash/debris accumulation:
1) (Repeat x2) The 2 prep coolers in the pizza prep area to have sauce splash on the insides of prep cooler lids. 
2) The bottom of the pizza prep cooler. 
3) The top of the dish machine. 

Discussed with PIC, areas will be cleaned. Ensure facility is cleaning non food contact surfaces at a frequency that prevents food splash/debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Observed caulking to need replaced in the following areas:
1) (Repeatx2) Triple sink to the right of dish machine.
2) (Repeat) Mop sink. 

Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure facility is monitoring caulking.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
